# Module `events`

Events (DOM Standard: EventTarget, Event; UI Events: MouseEvent, KeyboardEvent). Any node and any host object (a
promise, a socket, a worker, an abort signal...) is an EventTarget. An Event handle is valid while its listeners run.

Exposed to: Window, Worker. Source: `api/events.widl`.

## Types

### handle `EventTarget`

A node or a host object: whatever can have listeners. Checked by the functions that take it.

### handle `Event`

The event being dispatched.

Checked by the browser on every call (`lookup_Event`).

### flags `ListenerOptions` : u32

addEventListener options.

| member | bit | |
|---|---:|---|
| `Capture` | 0 | Run in the capture phase. |%!(EXTRA false)
| `Once` | 1 | Remove the listener after its first call. |%!(EXTRA false)
| `Passive` | 2 | The listener will not call preventDefault. |%!(EXTRA false)

### flags `EventInit` : u32

What dispatchEvent creates.

| member | bit | |
|---|---:|---|
| `Bubbles` | 0 |  |%!(EXTRA false)
| `Cancelable` | 1 |  |%!(EXTRA false)
| `Composed` | 2 | The event crosses shadow roots (no effect yet: there are none). |%!(EXTRA false)

### callback `EventListener`

```
void EventListener(i32 user, Event event)
```

A listener: `user` is the value given to addEventListener.

### `EventTarget_dispatchEngineEvent`

```
bool EventTarget_dispatchEngineEvent(EventTarget target, string type, EventInit init, i64 engine_id, f64 time_stamp) raises
```

target.dispatchEvent(event) for an Event the engine owns: like EventTarget_dispatchEvent, with the engine's
identifier of the object (Event_engineId gives it back to the listeners) and its timeStamp. Returns false when a
listener cancelled it. The event is not trusted (isTrusted is false).

Raises: returns an `Error` (see [web](web.md)).

Host: `EventTarget_dispatchEngineEvent :: proc(c: ^Call, target: u64, type: string, init: Api_EventInit, engine_id: i64, time_stamp: f64) -> (bool, Api_Error)`
